description: Defines the Menu class representing a navigational menu item with properties like code, url, icon, role, and a list of submenus; includes JSON serialization annotations.

classes.name: Menu
classes.description: Serializable class modeling a web menu item with attributes such as code, url, icon, role, order, and nested submenus.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code identifier of the menu item.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code identifier of the menu item.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL associated with the menu item.

methods.name: setUrl
methods.description: Sets the URL for the menu item.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the order position of the menu item.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Sets the order position of the menu item.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Returns the icon associated with the menu item.

methods.name: setIcon
methods.description: Sets the icon for the menu item.

methods.name: getRole
methods.description: Returns the role associated with the menu item.

methods.name: setRole
methods.description: Sets the role for the menu item.
